metric_definitions.rgb_mse: Mean squared error across all H*W*3 normalized RGB components, before PNG rounding.
metric_definitions.rgb_psnr_db: 10*log10(1/rgb_mse), with fixed peak=1; null and is_infinite=true for zero MSE.
metric_definitions.channel_mae_rgb: Mean absolute normalized error separately in R, G, B order.
metric_definitions.missing_mse: Mean squared error over the 2*H*W unmeasured RGB components only.
metric_definitions.measurement_max_abs_error: Maximum absolute normalized difference at the H*W measured components.
metric_definitions.pooled_psnr: PSNR computed from total squared error divided by total component count.
metric_definitions.mean_per_image_psnr: Arithmetic mean of per-image PSNR; infinite if any image has zero MSE.
metric_definitions.runtime_seconds: Wall-clock reconstruction call only; excludes input/output, validation, and metrics.
